question: Can the exact currently installed Claude Code, Codex, and OMP releases consume the self-contained oh-my-ai 0.1.40 Agent Plugin through Plugnz's managed route?

environment.mode: fresh HOME, XDG roots, OPEN_PLUGIN_HOME, and host roots; real installed native binaries; empty OMP working directory outside every ambient plugin tree
environment.credentials: none copied or inherited by native MCP probes

nativeProof.command: claude plugin details oh-my-ai@local; claude mcp list

hosts.adapterCorrection: Claude's native loader reads .mcp.json and expands CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT. Plugnz now projects canonical mcp.json to that native twin, translates the portable PLUGIN_ROOT placeholder, and refuses conflicting declarations before activation.

hosts.routeLimit: Only the managed route is newly admitted. Native marketplace update remains pinned to its separate 0.162.0 evidence.

nativeProof.command: installed OMP loadSkills plus discoverAndLoadMCPTools with a 30 second startup bound

lifecycleProof.fixture: A small self-contained Agent Plugin with one ordinary skill, one referenced resource, and one stdio MCP server exercised the same managed replacement and retirement pipeline after the full oh-my-ai native discovery proof.

nativeAfterUpdate.claude-code: native plugin details found the v2 skill and native MCP list remained connected
nativeAfterUpdate.codex: native app-server skills/list found the v2 skill; bundled MCP validity is established by the full oh-my-ai probe
nativeAfterUpdate.omp: native skill discovery found the v2 skill and referenced resource; bundled MCP validity is established by the full oh-my-ai probe

nativeAfterRetirement.claude-code: plugin details refused the retired plugin
nativeAfterRetirement.codex: app-server skills/list returned no compat-proof skill
nativeAfterRetirement.omp: native skill discovery returned no compat-proof skill

lifecycleProof.retention: A plugin-data sentinel survived retirement in each native store.

failedAttempts: The first Claude probe found zero MCP servers and led to the mcp.json-to-.mcp.json adapter correction.
The first OMP probe ran below /root, where native project discovery correctly found an ambient project plugin; rerunning from a fresh /tmp directory isolated the user plugin.
The first Codex assertion expected an obsolete execute tool name; native discovery returned the artifact's actual cell tool.

The small lifecycle fixture's MCP process did not complete native discovery in Codex or OMP. Those attempts are retained outside Git; the admission composes the full artifact's native MCP proof with the same adapter's changed-byte skill/resource replacement proof rather than treating the fixture MCP result as affirmative evidence.
admission: Managed install, changed-byte update, and retirement only for exact releases 2.1.285, 0.161.0, and 18.8.7. Admitted package semantics are ordinary-skills, mcp, resources, plus adapter-owned auto-update-control, readback, rollback, activation-reload, retirement, and retention-safety. Disable, commands, agents, invocation policy, neighboring-release, and interval compatibility are not inferred.
